rules.title: Externalize strings
rules.text: Keep user-facing strings in message catalogs with stable keys.

rules.title: ICU message format
rules.text: Use ICU message syntax for plurals and gender instead of string concatenation.

rules.title: Locale-aware formatting
rules.text: Format dates, numbers and currencies with Intl or the platform locale APIs.

rules.title: UTF-8 everywhere
rules.text: Use UTF-8 for storage, transport and files.

rules.title: Support right-to-left
rules.text: Use logical CSS properties so layouts work in right-to-left languages.

rules.title: No sentence assembly
rules.text: Never assemble translated sentences from fragments.
